summary: Completed patch compatibility analysis and directed testing for libxml2 commit b61737679e1f5ce2aaf19d075784a40bd5f4938a. The patch adds a negative-value check to parseInteger() in xmllint.c, affecting CLI options --maxmem, --pretty, and --max-ampl. Finding: INPUT_CONTRACT_CHANGE (HIGH priority) — negative values now rejected instead of silently wrapped by strtoul. Directed testing confirmed behavioral differences (error message changed from "integer out of range" to "value not allowed") with 100% patch line coverage (3/3 executable lines hit). All 22 CTest regression tests pass. Worktrees cleaned.
